 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # The patterned grid is a larger canvas; the cross-marked cells at row/column
    # intervals encode a small matrix. Recover the non-background colors at each
    # row and column where the pattern differs from the regular field.
    rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) > 1 and row.count(0) > 0]
    cols = [c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if any(grid[r][c] != grid[0][c] for r in range(len(grid)))]
    # Patterned ARC encoding can have varying base colors. Special rows are those
    # that interrupt the repeated background stripe; special columns likewise.
    rows = [r for r in range(len(grid)) if len(set(grid[r])) > 1]
    cols = [c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(len(grid))}) > 1]
    # Decode special-cell matrix by locating the repeating row/column stripe
    # separators: a row with many colors is a data row, and same for columns.
    data_rows = [r for r in rows if len(set(grid[r])) > 1]
    data_cols = [c for c in cols if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(len(grid))}) > 1]
    # Each data row/column intersection carries the encoded value, while the
    # regular patterned cells carry the frame. Output is the matrix of marks.
    return [[grid[r][c] for c in data_cols] for r in data_rows]

{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-hermes-luna6-high-seq0/frozen/seen/play/users/u082/system/state/workspace/programs/task-dc776e45.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # The input consists of regular background stripes interrupted by marker
    # rows. Each interval between consecutive marker rows becomes one output row.
    # For each pair of mirrored marker columns, preserve the color when it is
    # unchanged on both bordering marker rows; otherwise use the background.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    marker_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) > 1 and sum(v != grid[r][0] for v in grid[r]) > w // 2]
    if len(marker_rows) < 2:
        return []
    background = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    # Infer marker columns as columns that differ on marker rows from their
    # regular-grid value; adjacent repeated marker columns encode a single lane.
    marker_cols = []
    for c in range(w):
        vals = [grid[r][c] for r in marker_rows]
        if len(set(vals)) > 1 or any(v != background for v in vals):
            marker_cols.append(c)
    # Collapse consecutive/nearby duplicated marker positions into lanes.
    lanes = []
    for c in marker_cols:
        if not lanes or c - lanes[-1][-1] > 1:
            lanes.append([c])
        else:
            lanes[-1].append(c)
    out = []
    for ra, rb in zip(marker_rows, marker_rows[1:]):
        row = []
        for lane in lanes:
            a = [grid[ra][c] for c in lane]
            b = [grid[rb][c] for c in lane]
            ca = max(set(a), key=a.count)
            cb = max(set(b), key=b.count)
            row.append(ca if ca == cb else background)
        out.append(row)
    return out
",
 "cross_profile": false
}
